coach_says: TSB is -55.5 and Garmin flags UNPRODUCTIVE with declining fitness trend, so this week prioritises recovery above all else. The only quality session is Tuesday's non-negotiable hard MTB group ride; every other session is easy, short, or substituted with a light deload gym day to protect consistency without adding fatigue. Volume is cut roughly in half versus last week to allow ATL to fall and TSB to recover before reintroducing structured tempo/threshold work.

days.details: Complete rest. TSB -55.5 and Garmin UNPRODUCTIVE status require full recovery before Tuesday's committed hard MTB. Prioritise sleep, hydration, and light mobility if desired (optional 5-10 min gentle stretching only).

AM: Rest — no morning hard road ride this week, protecting the committed evening session given severe fatigue (TSB -55.5). PM: 60 min | Objective: Group ride intensity (Zone 4-5 surges). 10 min Zone 2 warm-up, group ride with variable hard efforts, 10 min Zone 1 cool-down. This is the week's single designated quality/high-intensity session — non-negotiable regardless of recovery status.

40 min | Objective: Active recovery from Tuesday's hard MTB
40 min continuous Zone 1-2, flat terrain, cadence 85-95rpm, conversational effort throughout. No intervals, no hills. Mandatory easy day per constraint.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x150m (first 50m easy / next 100m moderate), 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m easy
Total: ~1000m
Keep effort easy-moderate; this is a technique/aerobic maintenance session, not a quality workout given current fatigue.

70 min | Objective: Aerobic maintenance (recovery week - shorter than usual Friday long ride)
70 min steady Zone 1-2, flat-to-rolling terrain, no structured intervals. Aerobic_low load is already above target this training block, so keep this ride restrained rather than extending duration.

Workout A:
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility

Trap Bar Deadlift 3x5 (light-moderate load, RIR 3-4)
Reverse Lunge 2x8 each leg
Chest Supported Row 2x10
Dumbbell Bench Press 2x10
Pallof Press 2x10 each side
Dead Bug 2x8 each side

Main lifts: 2-3 min rest
Accessories: 60-90 sec rest

Note: Deload week — reduced sets/loads vs normal programming, nothing near failure, purpose is movement quality and light stimulus only given high accumulated fatigue.

90 min | Objective: Aerobic endurance without added fatigue
90 min Zone 1-2 steady state, rolling terrain acceptable, avoid climbs that push into Zone 3+. No intervals. Shorter than a typical big weekend ride to support ongoing recovery from unproductive training status.
